start: Member app, My membership, the gym asked for dues by Send to their app

user_sees: 'Scan this QR with any UPI app.'
'After you pay, the gym saves your receipt.'

steps.action: Tap Pay by UPI app, pay, come back
must_not: Paid shown before the money came

start: Member app, Shop, an order placed, not collected

user_sees: A payment page or UPI QR for the order total
must_not: An amount different from the order total
A payment for a cancelled or collected order
The order paid twice when its total changed (old link must close)

start: The owner switched off Take payments in the member app

steps.action: Open the request in My membership
must_not: A QR, UPI link or payment page shown

steps.action: A gym with nothing set up: open the shop order
user_sees: 'Online payment is not set up at this gym yet. Pay at the desk.'

start: A payment link older than its time limit

user_sees: 'This payment link has run out. Ask the desk for a new one.'

start: A payment try failed at the payment company

user_sees: 'Your last try did not go through. You can try again.'

start: Member app in test mode (PAY_LIVE off)

must_not: Other members' requests, ids or payment ids
Card, UPI or bank details kept by MettleUp
